name: anim_trio_absorbed_loop
subject: a pink paint goo Doberman monster and a pink paint goo crocodile monster lying on a paint puddle, hugging each other
desc: Loop: the two goo monsters keep hugging each other tightly and squeeze again and again; their merged goo bodies squish, bulge and ripple with each squeeze, a dark shape moving inside the goo, sticky goo strands stretching and dripping between them. Both keep their eyes half-closed with a smug, content smile. They stay lying in place. Heavy, sticky, gooey.
